description.text: This program could be taught both in English and Chinese. Master students could choose to be taught in Chinese or English language based on their own situation, and their degree dissertation could be chosen to be written in Chinese or English.

duration.text: The Tourism Management at Wuhan University of Technology is a 2.5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2916 USD/per year ￥ 21000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 6. Two recommendation letters(optional) From professor,associate professor or equivalents.

requirements.text: Non-Chinese, who haven’t broken laws, are required to have master degree.
